notes: Time slots can no longer be made to collide. What you have just set stays, anything it runs into is cut back to make room, and a slot with nothing left is removed -- with a line above the cards saying what happened and an Undo that puts the whole change back. Adding a slot puts it where there is room; deleting a station the schedule uses asks whether its slots move or go with it. A slot whose two times are the same now plays all day, and one that runs past midnight says so and belongs to the day it starts on. Three silent faults are fixed: a slot pointing at a deleted station left the radio playing at zero volume, 'turn off at the end of the day' fired on any midday gap and never came back on, and two slots in a row on one station reconnected instead of just changing settings. A refused save now marks the field at fault and says why, rather than naming a station by number. The download carries a proper manual, README.html, which Settings opens in a window of its own.
